plotting_plan.title: Main results
plotting_plan.objective: Two-panel grouped bar chart: validation perplexity and exact-match on CopyLong and Needle for Dense, Window, Static, and Ours.

plotting_plan.title: Ablation on the global-token budget
plotting_plan.objective: Grouped bar chart of Needle exact-match and CopyLong perplexity for the full model, no sparsity penalty, 12.5% global tokens, 50% global tokens, and a fixed gate.

plotting_plan.title: Routing schematic
plotting_plan.objective: Left-to-right schematic of a token sequence entering a gate, splitting into local-window and global-summary attention, and merging at the output.

introduction_strategy.hook_hypothesis: Attention-based language models are the dominant architecture, but dense attention scales quadratically with sequence length.
introduction_strategy.problem_gap_hypothesis: Fixed sparse patterns reduce cost but apply the same connectivity to every input, wasting computation on easy tokens and missing long-range dependencies on hard ones.
search_directions: Find papers establishing the compute and memory cost of dense attention
Find surveys of efficient Transformer architectures
Find foundational papers on sparse and adaptive attention

related_work_strategy.overview: Compare fixed sparsity, low-rank or recurrent efficiency, and adaptive computation, then position per-input routing as the missing combination.

subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Identify the main fixed-pattern and window-plus-global methods before the cutoff.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Fixed patterns cannot adapt to input content and require a hand-designed global-token budget.
limitation_search_queries: fixed sparse attention limitation content adaptivity
static attention pattern generalization long sequences
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: A learned gate chooses the local/global split per input.

subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Identify low-rank, hashing, and compressed-memory methods and their assumptions.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: These methods reduce cost through a fixed approximation or memory budget that is not input-dependent.
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: The router allocates global computation only to tokens that need it.

subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Identify adaptive-computation and differentiable discrete-selection methods.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Adaptive compute has been studied for recurrent depth and halting, not for per-token attention connectivity.
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: We apply a straight-through gate to attention connectivity.
